method: Emitted linked raw_bbox bottom-center; signed perpendicular distance to native finite G3 line; sign pairs require consecutive frames and proper finite-line intersection. Excursion = contiguous measured sign run bracketed by opposite sign and return. No state-machine replay, object counts or classification evaluation.

proposed_sensitivity_candidates.reason: 0/1 geometric control. Positive bands are observed median and maximum absolute distance of measured <=3-observation return excursions (n=3). Maximum is a stress sensitivity value, not a noise/default estimate. Confirmation values one greater than observed short excursion run lengths. This tests suppression/retention sensitivity; excursions are not ground-truth jitter, and real reversals/class handoff may be present.

source_review_coverage.limits: Broad burst contact sheets contain six sample frames, not all30frames. Contact sheets are reduced annotated evidence, not full-resolution raw temporal frames; no complete video pixel replay available locally. Cached measurement diagnostics cover every aligned frame.

interpretation_limits: Measured sign reversals do not prove jitter or actual physical-object reversals.
Tracker IDs can represent components/duplicate identities; raw detector classes are not accepted product categories.
No accuracy, traffic count, physical-identity count, best threshold or Phase6 business policy is established.
